user.title: Pair with RE.FILL
user.description: Open RE.FILL, choose Home Assistant, and copy the pairing code it shows you. This integration only sends data out — it never accepts a connection in, and it does not need a Home Assistant access token.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair with RE.FILL again
reauth_confirm.description: This hub was unpaired. Get a new pairing code from RE.FILL to start sending levels again — your device history is kept.

error.invalid_code: That code was not accepted. Codes last 10 minutes and work once — get a fresh one from RE.FILL.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach RE.FILL. Check this machine's internet connection and try again.

abort.already_configured: This hub is already paired with RE.FILL.

sync_now.name: Sync now
sync_now.description: Read consumable levels and send them to RE.FILL immediately.
